newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway central bank presents bond auction calendar.
newsitem.headline: Norway central bank presents bond auction calendar.

text.p: The Norwegian central bank on Monday presented the auction calendar for government bonds for the second half of this year.
It listed two announcements -- on September 15 and November 17.
The auctions may be cancelled or supplemented with Ad Hoc issues, the bank said in a statement.
The central bank auction calendar as follows:

The Finance ministry last year said it would need to raise new long-term domestic loans and new international loans of 50 billion crowns and 10 billion crowns respectively to cover state financing needs for the whole of 1997.
